# Private Testnet E2E Transactions

## 01. Register and delegate the Shelley block producer

Transaction ID: `c003fd4aeadb6c1e88931a5c1742b6e4f0c9661d8e291f2c4bc9cd8c8ed51f07`

This transaction spends a real Byron genesis UTxO to register the Shelley stake credential and pool, then delegates stake to that pool. It is needed because the mainnet-identity genesis cannot inject test-only Shelley staking state or initial funds, so block production must be enabled through real onchain certificates.

```text

```

## 02. Publish and fund initial fixtures

Transaction ID: `2d2450d9ad3e55c3a39620bd371372ae6061b3dfb20d99e2e6021f4a5784ce62`

This transaction splits faucet value into ordinary spending, collateral, runner-funding, and guardrail reference-script outputs. It is needed to provide the deliberately indexed UTxOs used by proposal construction, script evaluation, and the offchain scenario runner.

```text

```

## 03. Register and delegate the bootstrap DRep and authorize the bootstrap committee hot credential

Transaction ID: `e29218a89f064e25a936b0e11ba3cbd58b4a3c18966c6aabeaaccd8ee812e279`

This transaction registers the bootstrap DRep, delegates the active producer stake to it, and authorizes the constitutional committee hot credential. It is needed to establish governance authorities with meaningful active stake and an authorized committee voter.

```text

```

## 04. Submit the constitutionally guarded mainnet cost-model proposal

Transaction ID: `95d734986072ac61d80eeee85d900506a39d87c5132899d97a01b41392a45a8b`

This transaction submits a Conway protocol-parameter update containing the complete pinned mainnet Plutus V1, V2, and V3 cost models and references the constitutional guardrail script. It is needed because all later-era cost models cannot be injected legally at Alonzo genesis and must instead be enacted by real governance.

```text

```

## 05. Vote for the mainnet cost-model proposal as DRep and constitutional committee

Transaction ID: `114bdbf9f83417c3d4eb7226732f87d3fce2ececaee894caf4701f9dbd163678`

This transaction casts yes votes from the active bootstrap DRep and constitutional committee. It is needed to ratify the bootstrap parameter action and bring the chain to the pinned mainnet cost-model profile.

```text

```

## 06. Authorize the E2E committee hot credential

Transaction ID: `5e2f7348d40efd076f34a92c5a4b31c64ffd0b7e905c3cf179547f56a17ed1fb`

This transaction has the committee cold credential authorize the hot credential configured for the E2E runner. It is needed so the offchain committee wallet can cast its required vote on the scenario proposal.

```text

```

## 07. Register the proposal return stake credential

Transaction ID: `fab4e97b6ede665d5f9a7556be8efaebf4f54ae94284d724ea117a2e2878e301`

This transaction registers the funding base wallet's reward/stake credential. It is needed because the return account for a governance action deposit must be registered before the proposal is submitted.

```text

```

Transaction ID: `8800a93905f980313c396677a7a0fcdf13053ec161d365bf4a64188dfbf5006c`

This transaction creates three exact one-shot nonce outputs. They are needed to uniquely parameterize the governance, governance-action-lifespan, and parameters-contract minting policies.

```text

```

## 09. Distribute funds to scenario authorities

Transaction ID: `7317323c8c042134ed909120b7c087ab4d75d1d913540d6b54f8a43765f93003`

This transaction funds the generated DRep, committee hot wallet, and reference-script wallet. It is needed so each independent authority and deployment wallet has enough ADA for fees, deposits, and outputs.


Transaction ID: `0da80930bb059662c10fe2a63407048d31045c34db21dbcdd702ec135ee30616`

This transaction registers the generated DRep and delegates its wallet stake to its own DRep credential. It is needed to make that generated DRep a valid voter and exercise the intended registration and delegation path.

## 11. Register the finalizer script stake credentials

Transaction ID: `ab1dff6f2c4f452973d70f8508de3b7dfe0b3599fc8834cfeaa48124d43aebb2`

This transaction registers the parameters-contract and final-action staking-script reward credentials. It is needed because the ledger requires those credentials to be registered before zero-reward withdrawals can invoke their staking validators during finalization.

## 12. Publish the governance reference script

Transaction ID: `04082ca679b7b0475c887495226715c17ddd58f01a00134c17ce82bdbc027e66`

This transaction places the applied governance validator in a reference-script UTxO. It is needed so later governance state-machine transactions can witness the validator by reference instead of embedding its bytes repeatedly.

```text

```

## 13. Publish the parameters-contract reference script

Transaction ID: `86602b6ae410e85939bab8a25d4923bef92de7348aa294d217349a86ef5b6345`

This transaction places the applied application-parameters validator in a reference-script UTxO. It is needed so the finalization transaction can spend and invoke the parameters contract by reference.

```text

```

## 14. Publish the final-action reference script

Transaction ID: `4ada50a7b895ab4810171fe7b15d4c0d8caceec3ba904d67ec381208f9a8bde9`

This transaction places the applied fee-doubling final-action validator in a reference-script UTxO. It is needed so proposal finalization can invoke the action that authorizes the final state transition.

```text

```

## 15. Bootstrap the governance-action-lifespan configuration

Transaction ID: `278bb49a912856d3837400a0b03e5ab0829456687369f1dacfc71a8fca94c0ae`

This transaction consumes its deployment nonce, mints the `GOV_ACTION_LIFESPAN` token, and locks it with an inline datum of 120,000 milliseconds. It is needed to provide the controller-authenticated onchain source for the six-epoch proposal lifetime.

```text

```

## 16. Initialize the parameters contract

Transaction ID: `2acc9d44625da967d16e69b4ec786fcaca2e6f25a96e82844cfd205e2d27054b`

This transaction consumes its deployment nonce, mints the `PROTOCOL_PARAMETERS` token, and locks the initial parameters datum with a protocol fee of 1,000,000 lovelace. It is needed to create the stable application state that the governance proposal will later modify.

```text

```

## 17. Initialize governance

Transaction ID: `e4c2dfbe9528c3842f814925a674cdc8b317042ceaf201ad095df583be03ebf4`

This transaction consumes the governance deployment nonce and mints the linked-list root that represents an empty proposal list. It is needed to create the singleton root and initial onchain state of the governance state machine.

```text

```

## 18. Submit the cost-model proposal

Transaction ID: `244ab585b70ddbf09bed654262d84277973d3002b138e3c4357bdc42bef773ce`

This transaction inserts a sorted proposal node and submits its matching guarded ledger proposal to increment the Plutus V3 cost-model value for builtin 42 from 1 to 2, chained to the preceding governance action. It is needed to exercise the core validation pattern: canonical cost-model splicing, script-data-hash and transaction-ID reconstruction, return-credential checks, lifespan checks, and the constitutional guardrail.

```text

```

Transaction ID: `8e2088da1441f59ac0f8b791ec73fc086938725d442011b0209e116af70dee9c`

This transaction casts a yes vote from the generated DRep. It is needed to validate the generated authority's voting path, even though this DRep controls only a small amount of stake.

```text

```

## 20. Cast the bootstrap DRep vote

Transaction ID: `131b0edb3242e034f5863b00825d012bcc2bceb06d0a40654cad17925c39cd2c`

This transaction casts a yes vote from the active majority-stake bootstrap DRep using the exported signing key. It is needed for the proposal to satisfy the actual DRep ratification threshold.


## 21. Cast the committee hot wallet 0 vote

Transaction ID: `8b9cce07a3dd2b69e83b9437d6acb0090f1bf73f850e99ceb13ca7d40d1937dc`

This transaction casts a yes vote from the authorized constitutional committee hot credential. It is needed for the proposal to satisfy constitutional committee acceptance.

```text

```

## 22. Mint the passed-proposal state

Transaction ID: `e0556dc6197cd53ceb922337e27fee4104a295b052354060d00f047e1a511831`

After ledger enactment, this transaction removes the live proposal node and mints the passed-proposal token and state. It is needed to bridge the enacted ledger action into application state and permit controlled finalization.

```text

```

## 23. Finalize the passed proposal

Transaction ID: `903bb1e2ca0d86a626c50151feaea117cb6b9ccebef5fd5b18f0937f7badcec4`

This transaction burns the passed-proposal token, invokes both staking scripts through zero-reward withdrawals, updates the parameters datum from a 1,000,000 to a 2,000,000 lovelace protocol fee, and reimburses the proposer. It is needed to demonstrate the authorized final action and complete cleanup of the passed proposal.

```text

```

## 24. Submit the unvoted reverse proposal

Transaction ID: `3c921a6bb44da9eb26baae1be92d63382e5b9e344c3f16ea7608c58bad0d69b2`

This transaction submits a proposal to reverse the protocol fee from 2,000,000 to 1,000,000 lovelace, chained to the action that just passed, and deliberately receives no votes. It is needed to create a controlled expiry case while exercising proposal insertion a second time.

```text

```

## 25. Remove the expired proposal

Transaction ID: `3c34c3a319d2300e1bfb960fd8476dde7ac60432346c6fbb0b176af09ae0b6ae`

After six epochs, this transaction removes the expired proposal node and refunds the proposer. It is needed to prove the timeout cleanup path and return the governance linked list to its empty state.

```text

```
